parameters.content:
## Phase 5 - automated scenario + supplier proof (no AI)
- Reads only Phase 4 products with measured AliExpress competition.
- Reparses saved captures locally with the current extractor: no search, Chrome, CAPTCHA, Phase 2, 3 or 4 rerun.
- Uses captured FR/EUR shipping cost and maximum delivery estimate when available.
- Automatically builds a target-margin price scenario and fills operating assumptions.
- Existing Sheet values always override defaults. Configure defaults once with PHASE5_* n8n variables.
- Every automatic assumption is recorded in validation_notes.
- Exact variant, product compliance and sample approval remain evidence gates.

Before running: restart port 8787 after code updates and import this workflow version.
